name: @agentic-toolkit/adh-admin
description: The Admin console feature: users, invitations, feature flags, server bags, sync, audit, messaging, feedback, authentication, LLM providers, usage limits, and reserved identifiers.
comment:tier: VOCABULARY, not mechanism — see scripts/check_boundaries.py, which classifies on the `@agentic-toolkit/adh` name boundary alone. This package imports BOTH vocabulary (adh, adh-api-types, adh-ui) and mechanism (api-explorer, auth, resource) packages, which only a vocabulary name may do. The `adh-` prefix is a deliberate claim about the CONTENT — every shape in src/api/*.ts is a column of adh's own schema (customer.customers, system.feature_flags, usage.rate_limit_tiers, …), and the panes' copy names adh's own admin surface (isAdmin(), the hub ecosystem, adh's messaging providers) — so a non-adh host mounting this would be mounting adh's model of administration, not a general one.
